text.en: Latent Diffusion Models is row 81 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Diffusion Model Application area.
text.zh: Latent Diffusion Models 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 81 行，所属领域为“扩散模型应用”。

text.en: The annual table associates Latent Diffusion Models with “High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Latent Diffusion Models 与论文《High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Robin Rombach, Andreas Blattmann, Bjorn Ommer”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 罗宾·罗姆巴赫、安德烈亚斯·布拉特曼、比约恩·奥默；官方英文原文为“Robin Rombach, Andreas Blattmann, Bjorn Ommer”。

text.en: Latent Diffusion Models uses perceptual compression followed by conditional diffusion in latent space.
text.zh: Latent Diffusion Models 采用感知压缩后在潜空间进行条件扩散。

text.en: Experts generally treat latent diffusion as the efficiency breakthrough that made high-quality text-to-image generation broadly deployable. Its architecture became central to Stable Diffusion and to a large ecosystem of conditioning, editing and personalization methods.
text.zh: 专家通常把潜扩散视为让高质量文生图得以广泛部署的效率突破。其架构成为 Stable Diffusion 以及大量条件控制、编辑和个性化方法的核心。
